whitePrivateLabel.title: White or Private label
whitePrivateLabel.subtitle: What's the difference?
whitePrivateLabel.intro: Supsuppliers offers both white label and private label solutions for your own brand. But what exactly is the difference?
whitePrivateLabel.whiteDesc: With white label, you choose products from our existing range. These products are immediately available from stock and can quickly be fitted with your own label. Ideal for a quick start with low minimum orders.
whitePrivateLabel.whiteBenefits: Immediately available|Low minimum orders|Quick to market|Proven formulas
whitePrivateLabel.privateDesc: With private label, we develop a unique custom product together with you. You determine the composition, flavor, and packaging. Fully tailored to your wishes and target audience.
whitePrivateLabel.privateBenefits: Unique formula|Custom composition|Made to order|Stand out in the market
whitePrivateLabel.ctaDesc: Request a quote today and discover the possibilities for your own brand.

productenSamples.title: Products & Samples
productenSamples.subtitle: Our assortment
productenSamples.intro: Supsuppliers has an extensive range of powdered nutrition and dietary supplements. All products are produced in our FSSC22000 certified production facility.
productenSamples.qualityDesc: All our products are produced according to the highest quality standards. Our production facility is FSSC22000 certified, guaranteeing that we meet the strictest food safety requirements.
productenSamples.assortmentItems: Whey protein shakes|Meal shakes|Pre-workouts|Post-workouts|BCAAs|Creatine|Plant-based protein products|Weight gainers|Vitamins & minerals
productenSamples.packagingDesc: We offer various packaging options, including jars, bags (pouches), and sachets. The packaging is fully customized to your wishes.
productenSamples.samplesDesc: Want to taste before you decide? Simply order a sample package and test our products for flavor, texture, and quality.

design.title: Design
design.subtitle: Your label design
design.intro: A professional label is the calling card of your brand. Supsuppliers offers three design packages, so there's always an option that fits your budget and needs.
design.basicDesc: Simple but professional label design based on your logo and brand identity.
design.standardDesc: Extended label design with multiple concepts and more revision rounds.
design.standardFeatures: 2 design concepts|4 revision rounds|Print-ready file|Mockup presentation
design.premiumDesc: Fully custom design with extensive support.
design.premiumFeatures: 3 design concepts|Unlimited revisions|Print-ready file|Mockup presentation|Brand identity advice
design.extraDesc: In addition to label design, we also offer additional design services, such as logo design, brand identity, or packaging design.

labels.title: Labels
labels.subtitle: Professional labels by Eshuis
labels.intro: Supsuppliers works with Eshuis, a leading printing company in the Netherlands, for printing your labels. This guarantees a professional appearance of your products.
labels.partnerDesc: Eshuis is an experienced printing company that has been delivering top-quality labels for years. Through our partnership, we can offer competitive prices with fast delivery times.
labels.processDesc: After approval of your label design, printing begins. Eshuis delivers the labels directly to Supsuppliers, where they are applied to your products.
labels.volumeDesc: With higher print runs, the cost price drops significantly and Supsuppliers can keep your labels in stock for faster delivery on follow-up orders!

shakebekers.title: Shaker Cups & Drink Bottles
shakebekers.subtitle: With your logo
shakebekers.intro: Give your brand an extra boost by choosing custom printed shaker cups and drink bottles. We deliver high quality products at a low rate with fast delivery.
shakebekers.shakerDesc: Our shaker cups are made from high-quality BPA-free material and feature a practical sieve for lump-free shakes. Available in various colors and fully customizable with your logo or design.
shakebekers.bottleDesc: Our drink bottles are made from durable BPA-free tritan. We offer sharp prices and fast delivery for personalized drink bottles. Ideal as an addition to your supplement line.
shakebekers.benefits: BPA-free material|High quality|Low minimum orders|Fast delivery times|Fully customizable|Various colors available

voedselveiligheid.title: Food Safety Plan
voedselveiligheid.subtitle: FSSC22000 certified
voedselveiligheid.intro: Supsuppliers attaches great importance to food safety. Our production facility is FSSC22000 certified, the highest standard in food safety.
voedselveiligheid.whatDesc: FSSC22000 is an internationally recognized food safety certification system. It combines ISO 22000 with additional technical specifications and ensures that the entire production chain meets the strictest requirements.
voedselveiligheid.whyDesc: With an FSSC22000 certified supplier, you can be sure that your products are produced under the highest quality and safety standards. This gives confidence to your customers and meets the requirements of retailers.

overigeInfo.title: Additional Information
overigeInfo.subtitle: Delivery & transport
overigeInfo.deliveryDesc: Supsuppliers strives to ship your order within 5 business days. However, this only applies after labels are in possession of Supsuppliers. When products are not in stock, you will be informed.
overigeInfo.postnlDesc: Supsuppliers ships small orders via PostNL. You will receive a track & trace in your email to follow your order. If you do not accept delivery, the order will be returned. Re-incurred shipping costs will be charged.
overigeInfo.transportDesc: Larger orders are shipped via a transport company. A delivery day is agreed upon and transport is scheduled. The courier will contact you by phone 30 minutes before arrival.
overigeInfo.pickupDesc: You can pick up the products yourself by appointment.
overigeInfo.packingDesc: With every shipment, a packing slip will show what is being delivered. You will also need to sign this packing slip (does not apply to PostNL). Keep your packing slip safe in your records.

stappenplan.title: Step-by-step plan
stappenplan.subtitle: Your own brand in 8 steps
stappenplan.step1Desc: Supsuppliers first advises you to order samples via our website. You will receive a sample package and can test the products for taste, effectiveness, etc.
stappenplan.step2Desc: After testing the samples, you make a choice from our product range (products and quantities).
stappenplan.step3Desc: You make a choice regarding design.
stappenplan.step5Desc: Once you have made a choice from the above, you can request a quote via the website.
stappenplan.step6Desc: Supsuppliers will contact you based on your quote. You will receive a quote from Supsuppliers by email.
stappenplan.step7Desc: After approval of the quote, the process regarding your choices is set in motion. You will receive an invoice by email. Once this is paid, we immediately start the order.
stappenplan.step8Desc: When your order is ready for shipment, you will receive a Track and Trace so you can follow the order live.

bedrijf.title: Company
bedrijf.subtitle: About Supsuppliers
bedrijf.intro: Supsuppliers is the Dutch supplier of powdered nutrition and dietary supplements. Located in Duiven, we are the foundation for the development, production, and packaging of your own supplement line.
bedrijf.missionDesc: We make it possible for everyone to start their own supplement brand. With low minimum orders, premium quality, and personal guidance from A to Z.
bedrijf.whatWeDoDesc: Supsuppliers offers the possibility to create a private label and is the foundation for the development, production, and packaging of: Whey protein shakes, meal shakes, pre-workouts, post-workouts, BCAAs, creatine, plant-based protein products, weight gainers, and more.
bedrijf.whyItems: FSSC22000 certified production|Low minimum orders|Fast delivery times|Personal guidance|Everything under one roof|Competitive prices
